data.one_liner: Offline-first sync engine for Serverpod using Conflict-free Replicated Data Types.
data.what_it_does: Turns an ordinary Serverpod backend into an offline-first, collaborative system using delta-CRDTs. It automatically handles data synchronization between client and server databases while maintaining relational integrity and unique constraints.
use_when: You are building a Serverpod application that needs to work fully offline.
You want automatic conflict resolution and space-based data sharing without writing custom merge logic.
avoid_when: You are not using Serverpod as your backend.
Your project cannot adhere to the package's specific data modeling limitations and reserved values.
strengths: Runs the exact same CRDT merge code on both client SQLite and server Postgres.
Preserves foreign-key actions and relational integrity automatically during merges.
Provides both one-shot sync and continuous real-time streaming sync.
weaknesses: Imposes strict data modeling limitations and reserved values on database schemas.
Tight coupling to the Serverpod ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding client and server packages, configuring the offline_sync module in generator.yaml, and enabling experimental database sync.
data.minimal_example:
final session = await client.createSyncSession(databasePath);
await client.offlineSync.syncOnce(session);
